segments.sn24.7:1.2: “Kismiṃ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṃ upādāya, kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.7:1.5: Natthi hetu, natthi paccayo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā.
segments.sn24.7:1.7: Natthi balaṃ natthi vīriyaṃ natthi purisathāmo natthi purisaparakkamo.
segments.sn24.7:1.8: Sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā sabbe bhūtā sabbe jīvā avasā abalā avīriyā niyatisaṅgatibhāvapariṇatā chasvevābhijātīsu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī’”ti?
segments.sn24.7:2.1: “rūpe kho, bhikkhave, sati, rūpaṃ upādāya, rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.7:2.7: viññāṇe sati, viññāṇaṃ upādāya, viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.7:3.4: vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.7:3.13: api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.7:3.17: “Yampidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.7:3.19: api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.7:4.1: “Yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa imesu ca ṭhānesu kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhepissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti …pe… dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāyapissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti –
segments.sn24.7:4.2: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano”ti.

lines: Ubhayenāpi vijjamānameva kāyaduccaritādīnaṃ saṃkilesapaccayaṃ, kāyasucaritādīnañca visuddhipaccayaṃ paṭikkhipanti.
Natthi balanti yamhi attano bale patiṭṭhitā ime sattā devattampi mārattampi brahmattampi sāvakabodhimpi paccekabodhimpi sabbaññutampi pāpuṇanti, taṃ balaṃ paṭikkhipanti.
“Idaṃ no vīriyena, idaṃ purisathāmena, idaṃ purisaparakkamena patta”nti, evaṃ pavattavacanapaṭikkhepakaraṇavasena panetāni visuṃ ādiyanti.
Sabbe pāṇāti ekindriyo pāṇo, dvindriyo pāṇotiādivasena vadanti.
Avasā abalā avīriyāti tesaṃ attano vaso vā balaṃ vā vīriyaṃ vā natthi.
Evaṃ niyatiyā ca saṅgatiyā ca bhāvena ca pariṇatā nānappakārataṃ pattā.
Yena hi yathā bhavitabbaṃ, so tatheva bhavati.
Yena na bhavitabbaṃ, so na bhavatīti dassenti.
Chasvevābhijātīsūti chasu eva abhijātīsu ṭhatvā sukhañca dukkhañca paṭisaṃvedenti, aññā sukhadukkhabhūmi natthīti dassenti. 8-10.
Natthi balanti sattānaṃ diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikanibbānasampattiāvahaṃ balaṃ nāma kiñci natthi.

Aññamaññavevacanānīti tassā tassā kiriyāya ussannaṭṭhena balaṃ, sūravīrabhāvāvahaṭṭhena vīriyaṃ, tameva daḷhaggāhabhāvato porisaṃ dhuraṃ vahantena pavattetabbato purisathāmo, paraṃ paraṃ ṭhānaṃ akkamanappavattiyā purisaparakkamoti vuttoti veditabbaṃ.
Satvayogato, rūpādīsu vā sattatāya sattā, pāṇanato assāsanapassāsanavasena pavattiyā pāṇā, te pana so ekindriyādivasena vibhajitvā vadatīti āha “ekindriyo”tiādi.
Jīvanato pāṇaṃ dhārentā viya vaḍḍhanato jīvāti sāliyavādike vadanti.
Tattha tattha gamananti channaṃ abhijātīnaṃ vasena tāsu tāsu gatīsu upagamanaṃ.
Sabhāvoyevāti yathā kaṇṭakassa tikkhatā, kapitthaphalānaṃ parimaṇḍalatā, migapakkhīnaṃ vicittākāratā, evaṃ sabbassapi lokassa hetupaccayehi vinā tathā tathā pariṇāmo, ayaṃ sabhāvo eva akittimo eva.
Sukhañca dukkhañca paṭisaṃvedentīti vadantā adukkhamasukhabhūbhiṃ sabbena sabbaṃ na jānantīti ulliṅgento “aññā sukhadukkhabhūmi natthīti dassentī”ti āha.
